__comments.description: Decision rules for patient matching in the Philippine community health context
__comments.matchingType: deterministic uses score_mode:sum — each matched field adds its weight to the score. Final score = match_all(1.0) + sum_of_matched_fields.
__comments.why_no_national_id_rule: The record-linkage plugin treats empty strings as valid values (not null). Since nationalid is indexed as empty string for patients without IDs, comparing '' vs '' yields a perfect match score. National ID rule should only be added after patching OpenCR indexing to omit empty fields from OpenSearch.

rules.__comment: Demographic match — requires ALL 4 fields to auto-match (score 5 = match_all 1.0 + 4 fields x weight 1.0)
